text:
sara: Hey all — quick mini release check: final call for one-liners and PR labels before tomorrow's cutoff (10:00 PT). Please add a `release-ready` label and a one-liner to the PR body. Examples below.

mike: Added label to #1734 and put a one-liner in the body. Do we need component tags?

SARA: yes — add `component: eng-runtime` or `component: eng-releases` depending on ownership, but keep it short. Example template: ```- component: eng-runtime
- one-liner: Reduces token marshalling overhead by 12%```

liz: tiny nit — prefer present-tense verbs and a subject when helpful. e.g., use "Reduces" or "Improves" rather than "Reduced". Also please avoid trailing periods.

pranav: Pinging reviewers: @jon @deb for #1740 (small version bump + changelog entry).

jon: on it, can do a quick pass after standup (~09:30).

release-bot: :bell: Automated reminder: RELEASE CUTOFF in ~14 hours. Ensure PRs have `release-ready` label and a changelog one-liner. See https://company.internal/release-guide for the exact template.

devx: One more ask — if the entry touches docs or public APIs, add `docs:` or `api:` prefixes in the one-liner so the generator can route it. We're trying to keep machine-parsable tags.

sara: If you know you won't make cutoff, mark the PR `post-release` and paste the one-liner into the PR body so we can pick it up for next cycle.

mike: :thumbsup: Done. Quick question — can we relax the one-liner width to 100 chars? Our writeups for multi-component changes are getting squashed by the 80-char lint.

liz: I'm fine with 100 chars. I'll update the release-lint check in `.github/llm-release-lint` and roll it out before cutoff.

pranav: Added `release-ready` and one-liner to #1740 and left a tiny rollback plan in the PR body per the template. @jon assigning to you.

jon: reviewed, approved. Left one suggestion to clarify the rollback command to run.

sara: thanks everyone — final sweep at 09:45 PT. I'll merge anything green + labeled; anything without the label I'll skip for this release.
